profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Oakland, California, that supports children and youth experiencing housing instability. It provides one-on-one tutoring and mentoring, early literacy programs, and school supplies, backpacks and books. It also helps with school attendance and raises awareness about housing instability and students' educational rights.
